## Purpose and Package Shape
This monorepo produces **daisyUI**, a Tailwind CSS component-library plugin: authored CSS components, utilities, and named themes are compiled into consumable npm/CDN bundles. It also owns the public documentation/site, interactive playground, and AI-editor skill/plugin distributions.

Primary package entry points are `packages/daisyui/index.js` for the Tailwind plugin and `packages/daisyui/build.js` for release artifact generation. Prebuilt distribution adapters live in `packages/bundle/daisyui.js` and `packages/bundle/daisyui-theme.js`.

## CSS Source Model
The product source is declarative CSS, organized by responsibility:
- Global/base behavior: `packages/daisyui/src/base/reset.css`, `packages/daisyui/src/base/properties.css`
- Reusable component class definitions: `packages/daisyui/src/components/button.css`, `packages/daisyui/src/components/modal.css`
- Theme token definitions: `packages/daisyui/src/themes/light.css`, `packages/daisyui/src/themes/dark.css`
- General-purpose styling utilities: `packages/daisyui/src/utilities/join.css`, `packages/daisyui/src/utilities/typography.css`

These files are the primary compatibility boundary: documentation examples, generated bundles, and user Tailwind builds all depend on their class names and CSS custom-property contracts.

## Plugin and Theme Runtime
`packages/daisyui/index.js` exposes the integration consumed by Tailwind CSS. Plugin assembly and user-option handling are separated in `packages/daisyui/functions/plugin.js` and `packages/daisyui/functions/pluginOptionsHandler.js`. Theme-specific registration is handled by `packages/daisyui/functions/themePlugin.js`.

Control flow is Tailwind configuration → daisyUI plugin/options → selected component/theme CSS and generated rules → Tailwind output. This is a Node.js/JavaScript build-time runtime, not a browser component runtime.

## Build and Distribution Pipeline
`packages/daisyui/build.js` orchestrates source-to-package generation. It discovers CSS, compiles/extracts styles, transforms CSS into JavaScript-compatible payloads, and creates package-facing files through modules such as `packages/daisyui/functions/compileAndExtractStyles.js`, `packages/daisyui/functions/generatePlugins.js`, and `packages/daisyui/functions/createPluginFiles.js`.

The pipeline’s output boundary is the published package and the checked-in bundle adapters under `packages/bundle/`. Changes to source CSS often require regenerated plugin/bundle artifacts rather than isolated edits.

## Documentation Application
`packages/docs` is a SvelteKit application serving documentation, component references, marketing content, store/skills pages, feeds, sitemap, and redirects. Its route root and shell are `packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/+layout.svelte` and `packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/+page.svelte`; SvelteKit endpoint entry points include `packages/docs/src/routes/search.csv/+server.js` and `packages/docs/src/routes/sitemap.xml/+server.js`.

Component documentation is MD(S)VEX route content, e.g. `packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/button/+page.md`, and should remain synchronized with the CSS source contract.

## Docs Content, Rendering, and Server Data
MD(S)VEX configuration and transforms govern markdown rendering, links, headings, embedded components, and syntax highlighting: `packages/docs/src/lib/mdsvex/mdsvex.config.js`, `packages/docs/src/lib/mdsvex/render-component.js`, `packages/docs/src/lib/mdsvex/highlighting/index.js`.

Server-side route loaders consume a content/data layer for catalogs, framework pages, comparisons, skills, store products, and media: `packages/docs/src/lib/server/content/catalog.js`, `packages/docs/src/lib/server/content/componentIndex.js`, `packages/docs/src/lib/server/content/store.js`. This separates filesystem/content interpretation from Svelte route presentation.

## Ancillary Delivery Surfaces and Infrastructure
The browser playground exercises generated daisyUI styles across LTR/RTL, themes, prefixing, and demos: `packages/playground/build-daisyui.js`, `packages/playground/src/pages/main.js`. `packages/tailwind-play-share/index.mjs` supports Tailwind Play sharing/preview integration.

AI-oriented documentation is distributed as skills and editor plugins, centered on `skills/daisyui/SKILL.md`, `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, and `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`. GitHub Actions provide test, release, documentation deployment, and Tailwind Play PR-preview automation: `.github/workflows/run-tests.yml`, `.github/workflows/release-new-version.yml`, `.github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml`.
